title: Unisex Christmas – We Said No Gifts Tee

seo.title: Couples Christmas Shirt: We Said No Gifts Tee
seo.description: A funny couples Christmas shirt: we said no gifts, we lied. A 1960s pair hides presents. Unisex 4.2 oz cotton tee, S-4XL. Free size exchange.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

We said no gifts. We lied: a funny couples Christmas shirt for the pair who broke the deal again, each hiding a present from the other. Wear one yourself or put two in the cart for a matching pair (each tee is sold singly), and it is a good one among the Christmas gifts for couples that owns up to it.

The print is a 1960s storybook scene in faded red, mustard, pine green and cream: a smiling husband in a cardigan and a wife in a sweater and pleated skirt stand back to back in front of a small decorated tree, each holding a big wrapped present with a ribbon bow on the side the other cannot see. WE SAID NO GIFTS. runs across the top in red slab capitals and We lied. sits below in black script.

Wear it to the family party or Christmas Eve at home, alone or as a matching pair, or give it to the couple who swears every year that this one is a no-gift Christmas. Printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (heather colors contain polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction, shoulder-to-shoulder taping
  • Sizes S–4XL
  • Colors: White, Natural, Heather Dust, Athletic Heather, Ash, Tan
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Honduras, or the US

Questions

What is the We Said No Gifts tee?
It is a unisex Christmas graphic tee from Graphic Tees Co. with a 1960s husband and wife standing back to back, each hiding a wrapped present, lettered WE SAID NO GIFTS. We lied. It is printed on a Bella+Canvas 3001 in 4.2 oz cotton, so it stays light at a crowded family party.

How does the unisex tee fit him and her?
This Graphic Tees Co. tee is a classic unisex cut in sizes S through 4XL with a crew neck and side-seamed body. He can order his usual size and she can size down for a closer fit or stay true for a classic one. The first size exchange is free.

How do I order a matching pair?
Each Graphic Tees Co. tee is sold singly, so a pair means two in your cart, one in his size and one in hers, in the same color or two different ones. Orders over $45 ship free, and two tees at $24.99 each qualify for free US shipping.

How do I wash it so the print lasts?
Wash your We Said No Gifts tee inside out in cold water and tumble dry low. It is 100% combed ring-spun cotton at 4.2 oz, with some polyester in the heather colors, and the red, mustard and green inks stay crisp through every Christmas party and wash.

Can I get it by Christmas?
Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. We Said No Gifts tee should arrive before Christmas. Each shirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. The free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
